outcome: Cesarean delivery rate for the second twin
cohort: 713 twin pregnancies with the first twin delivered vaginally at more than 24 weeks gestation between 1995 and 2015 at a single teaching hospital
finding: An inter-twin delivery interval of 30 minutes or more was not a significant risk factor for umbilical artery pH less than 7.1 and/or Apgar score less than 7 in the second twin.
mod_finding: The cesarean delivery rate for the second twin was higher among those with an inter-twin delivery interval of 30 minutes or more compared to those with an interval of less than 30 minutes.
